newsitem.title: PANAMA: Ecuador's president hopes to end conflict with Peru.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's president hopes to end conflict with Peru.

text.p: Ecuador's President Abdala Bucaram said on Saturday he hopes a border conflict between his country and Peru can be resolved at a meeting in Brazil in February.
"It is better to be friends than to be at conflict," he told a news conference during a three-day visit to Panama.
Bucaram, who flies to Lima on Monday to meet with Peru's President Alberto Fujimori, said he would "speak openly" with the Peruvian leader in preparation for the Feb. 17 meeting.

The meeting in Brasilia will seek to end a centuries-old territorial dispute between Ecuador and Peru over a stretch of Andean jungle. It will also be attended by representatives from Brazil, Chile, Argentina and the United States.
"I think Fujimori is a gentleman and a good friend. I think both countries really want to solve this conflict peacefully because we are from the same Latin American cradle," he said.
The border dispute boiled over into a brief, but bloody war two years ago.
